item.title: Apex Legends™: Marked Midseason Patch Notes
item.description:
INTRO

Welcome back to Split 2 of Apex Legends: Marked. To start the second half of the season, we’ve got Legend balancing changes, some adjustment to loot availability (including more healing items), buffs to a trio of long range weapons, and the usual array of tweaks, fixes and adjustments. Split 2 starts on September 15th, so assemble your squad and get ready to jump back into Marked!

item.title: "Silk & Silver" Dev Diary #6 - Merchants, Republics, & the Silk Road
item.description:
Hello everyone,

It is time for us to give another update on all things that are happening on Silk & Silver. As Joachim mentioned during the last Dev Diary, we are currently deep in the Iteration phase of the project. Lots of progress has been made so far, and we want to share some of the recent developments when it comes to our two new Government types for the expansion: Merchants and Republics.
